Wild Italy S7 L'antropocene - Il richiamo della foresta
programme.desc: Italija je posebna zemlja usred Sredozemlja gdje, bez obzira na brojno stanovništvo i dugu povijest civilizacije, glavni europski grabežljivci i dalje žive posve slobodno. Među njima su smeđi medvjedi, vukovi, risovi, orlovi, i svi oni iskorištavaju bogata staništa prepuna ostataka daleke prošlosti. To je prava škrinja s blagom koja od Alpa do otoka ispred Afrike skriva bogatstvo bioraznolikosti od neprocjenjive vrijednosti, tisuće vrsta biljaka i životinja, uključujući i najopasnije grabežljivce ovoga kontinenta.

programme.title: Špijun među pingvinima, serija
programme.desc: Nakon uspjeha koji je postigao BBC-jev dokumentarni film Polarni medvjed - špijun na ledu, ekipa je otišla korak dalje i osmislila tzv. pingvinke, niz robotskih kamera prerušenih u pingvine, njihove piliće i jaja. Ekipa se otputila do zaleđenoga Antarktika kako bi bolje proučila carske pingvine i dopunila priču o njima s posve drukčijim iskustvima od onih koje je ponijela s ekspedicija u pustinji Južne Amerike istražujući Humboldtove pingvine i s Falklanda gdje se bavila kukmastim pingvinima. U trodijelnoj dokumentarnoj seriji izbliza pratimo sve dramatične događaje i opasnosti s kojima se te ptice suočavaju tijekom godine, ali i neke komične situacije. Kako bi stigli do svojih gnjezdišta, carski pingvini moraju prijeći opasno, zaleđeno more. Kad stignu na kopno, ženke jaja moraju snesti tako da ne dodiruju zaleđeno tlo, ali mužjaci su ti pred kojima je najveći izazov. Kukmasti pingvini suočavaju se s posve drugom vrstom izazova. Moraju preplivati najuzburkanije more na Zemlji, a potom, kad se napokon domognu obale, čeka ih iscrpljujući uspon na 100 metara visoku stijenu. Kako bi stigli do svojih gnjezdišta u pustinji, Humboldtovi pingvini se moraju probiti kraj 20.000 krvoločnih morskih lavova, izbjeći šišmiše-vampire i boriti se s pola milijuna oštrokljunih morskih ptica. --- 1. epizoda: Kako bi stigli do svojih gnjezdišta, carski pingvini moraju prijeći preko opasnog, zaleđenog mora, a na tom putu jedan se od njih izgubio u snježnoj oluji. Kad napokon stignu, ženke pokušavaju zavesti mužjake i one koje u tome uspiju kreću na "šetnju" sa svojim partnerima. Ženka svoje jaje mora snesti tako da ni u jednom trenutku ne dotakne zaleđeno tlo, ali mužjaci su ti koji će se suočiti s najvećim izazovom - moraju prezimiti sami na najhladnijem mjestu na Zemlji. Kukmasti pingvini moraju preplivati najuzburkanije more na Zemlji kako bi se dokopali kopna, gdje ih čeka strm uspon na 100 metara visoku stijenu, koji će oni svladati uglavnom poskakujući. Nakon što snesu jaja, morat će izdržati zračne napade polarnih skua i strvinara. Humboldtovi pingvini su neobični tropski pingvini o kojima ima veoma malo snimljenoga materijala. Kako bi stigli do svojih gnjezdišta u pustinji, moraju se probiti kraj 20.000 krvoločnih morskih lavova, izbjeći napade šišmiša-vampira i obraniti se od pola milijuna oštrokljunih morskih ptica. Sav taj golemi trud pingvinima se isplati kad se njihovi majušni, goli pilići napokon izlegnu. Među ovim kamerama-špijunkama koje izbliza snimaju jedinstveno ponašanja tih pingvina je posljednja riječ tehnologije: robot-pingvin koji umjesto očiju ima kamere.

programme.title: Špijun među pingvinima, serija
programme.desc: Pod budnim okom kamera-špijunki pilići se posvuda počinju pojavljivati iz jaja. Mužjaci carskoga pingvina staju u red za identifikaciju, prije nego li će piliće predati njihovim majkama koje se sada vraćaju. Majke se okupljaju u zbijene gomilice kako bi piliće zaštitile od ledene snježne oluje. Kamere kamuflirane kao pilići snimaju mladunce kako hodaju na majčinim nogama i kako čine svoj prvi nesiguran korak. Ženke koje nemaju vlastite piliće pokušavaju oteti tuđe. Na Falklandima, pilići kukmastoga pingvina susreću se s neobuzdanim susjedima - kraljevskim vrancima. Te će strvinare vojska pingvina ubrzo otjerati. Njihovi se roditelji penju do svojih privatnih kupki na stijeni. Piliće su napali novi grabežljivci, pa ražalošćeni roditelji planiraju otmicu susjedina pilića. U Peruu, pilići Humboldtovoga pingvina izleći će se usred pustinje. Odrasli napuštaju svoja gnijezda koja su oblijepili blatom i dobro bi im došlo kupanje. U moru im se pridružuju kamere - pingvini i razigrani tuljani. Ostavši sami kod kuće, pilići gađaju nasrtljive galebove svojim izmetom, a kolonija se suočava s velikom invazijom vranaca.

Planet prirodnih čuda
programme.desc: Spektakularna oda najvećim prirodnim čudima našeg planeta, mjestima koja zaista oduzimaju dah, a istodobno su nevjerojatan izazov za ljude koji na njima žive. Nakon velikog uspjeha prve sezone ove BBC-eve serije, nova sezona donosi još ekstremnih primjera kako ljudi preživljavaju, pa čak i odnose pobjede, u nekima od najnesmiljenijih uvjeta na Zemlji. Golemi planinski lanci, neprobojne kišne šume i golema ledena prostranstva... To su mjesta na kojima je priroda u svojem najmoćnijem, najljepšem, a katkad i najnemilosrdnijem izdanju. Kombinirajući najbolja znanstvena dostignuća i umijeće snimanja prirode, prekrasna fotografija u ovoj seriji pruža gledateljima priliku da istinski dožive te nevjerojatne krajolike i urone u začuđujuće priče njihovih stanovnika. Serija otkriva kako se ljudi koji su se prilagodili ovim mjestima i evoluirali s njima služe nevjerojatnim vještinama, domišljatošću i hrabrošću u borbi za opstanak. Priče uključuju kauboje koji zamjenjuju konje helikopterima i opasno nisko lete kako bi upravljali stadima u nepreglednim i nemilosrdnim predjelima australske divljine te Eskimke koje u arktičkim predjelima Kanade izlažu živote pogibelji kako bi skupile dagnje ispod pokretnog morskog leda koje će biti prilog uz tuljanovo meso.

Martha Argerich - A Birthday Celebration - I
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Iddo Bar-Shaï, and Arielle Beck; violinists Gidon Kremer, Maxim Vengerov, and Tedi Papavrami; cellist Mischa Maisky, Flugelhorn player Sergei Nakariakov, as well as her daughter and grandson: Lyda Chen-Argerich (piano and viola) and David Chen-Argerich (piano). This performance was recorded on June 11, 2021.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28. This episode of ‘In Rehearsal’ offers an intimate look at the dialogue between Mehta and the musicians as they explore Strauss’s tone poem together. Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28. Renowned as one of the world’s foremost interpreters of the great symphonic repertoire—especially the Romantic works of Anton Bruckner, Gustav Mahler, and Richard Strauss—Mehta had conducted this popular masterpiece many times before. However, this was the first occasion he rehearsed it from the very beginning with the orchestra. This episode of ‘In Rehearsal’ offers an intimate look at the dialogue between Mehta and the musicians as they explore Strauss’s tone poem together.

programme.title: Mozart - Mass in c minor, K. 427
programme.desc: In January 1783 Mozart wrote to his father that his Mass No. 17 in C minor KV 427 ‘Grosse Messe’ was halfway finished, but when he arrived in Salzburg in July of the same year the mass was still incomplete. The full version is performed by Gächinger Kantorei Stuttgart and the Bach Collegium Stuttgart with conductor Helmuth Rilling. This rendition of Mozart’s Mass in c minor, KV 427 by the Gächinger Kantorei Stuttgart, Bach-Collegium Stuttgart and conductor Helmuth Rilling is recorded at the Knights Hall in Schloss Wolfegg. Soloists are Ibolya Verebics, Andrea Rost, Uwe Heilmann and Daniel Lichti. After Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart had married Constanze Weber on the 4th of August 1782, he promised to compose a mass in her honour. He intended for the mass to be performed during the newlyweds’ visit to Mozart’s father in Salzburg. In January 1783 Mozart wrote to his father that his Mass in C minor ‘Grosse Messe’ was halfway finished, but when he arrived in Salzburg in July of the same year the mass was still incomplete. He would never finish the mass.The parts of the mass that Mozart did manage to compose (the Kyrie and Gloria) had their opening on the 26th of October 1783 in Salzburg, with Constanze as solo soprano.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birthday, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna). Schumann composed most of the work during his stay in Vienna in 1839, where he wrote the first four movements, presenting pictures of lively carnival revelry. He completed the fifth, last movement on his return to Leipzig. This piano cycle is among the composer’s most popular.

programme.title: Anton Arensky - Suite no.1, op.15 - II. Waltz
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021. In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart’s Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A; Ravel’s La Valse (arr. for two pianos); Arensky’s Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15; and Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance’ from Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture’ from Nikolai Kapustin’s Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4 - III. Allegro giocoso
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Johannes Brahms’s Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. Brahms completed his last symphony in 1885. He conducted the successful premiere of the piece in the German city of Meiningen in October of the same year. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Brahms: Hungarian Dance No. 6
programme.desc: For this exceptional recital, recorded in 2019 at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées, Camille (cello) and Julie Berthollet (violin) are accompanied by pianist Guillaume Vincent and the Ensemble Appassionato under the direction of Mathieu Herzog For this exceptional recital, recorded in 2019 at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées, Camille (cello) and Julie Berthollet (violin) are accompanied by pianist Guillaume Vincent and the Ensemble Appassionato under the direction of Mathieu Herzog. The two musical sisters have chosen a repertoire which crosses genres and eras to explore the expressive palette of the violin and cello, from the baroque of Vivaldi to the jazzy notes of Django Reinhardt and Stéphane Grapelli. Among the works on the program are Brahms Hungarian Dances No. 5 and No. 6, Karl Jenkins' Palladio, 'Theme from Forrest Gump' by Alan Silvestri, Schumann's Piano Quintet, Op. 44, The Red Violin by Corigliano, Hungarian Rhapsody, op. 68 by Popper, Minor Swing by Reinhardt/Grappeli and Csárdás by Monti.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 31, K. 297
programme.desc: Jeffrey Tate conducts the Mozarteum Salzburg Orchestra in a performance of Mozart’s Paris Symphony No. 31 (K. 297). The composer used the clarinets for the first time in a symphony, having heard the new instrument earlier in Mannheim. Jeffrey Tate conducts the Mozarteum Salzburg Orchestra in a performance of Mozart’s Paris Symphony No. 31 (K. 297). Mozart composed the work in 1778, during his unsuccessful job-hunting time in Paris. The opening movement of the Paris symphony is one of the grandest and most thrilling sounds Mozart ever made from an orchestra. The composer used the clarinets for the first time in a symphony, having heard the new instrument earlier in Mannheim. With horns, trumpets, timpani, and a full section of woodwind with flutes, oboes, clarinets, and bassoons, it is the biggest orchestra the composer had used until then. This broadcast is directed by János Darvos.

programme.title: Weinberg - Rhapsody on Moldovan Themes, Op.
programme.desc: The best youth orchestras in the world led by great conductors, and flanked by virtuoso soloists, guaranteed exciting and inspiring concert performances at the Young Euro Classical 2017. This select collection features infectiously energizing and outstanding performances by musicians from across the globe. Over the course of 19 days, the best youth orchestras in the world led by great conductors, and flanked by virtuoso soloists, guaranteed exciting and inspiring concert performances at the Young Euro Classical 2017. The festival is known to be the most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. This highlight version is a collection of infectiously energizing and outstanding performances by musicians from across the globe. Their repertoire includes renowned classical works as well as local composers. On the program: Verdi - La forza del destino, Beethoven - Meeresstille und glückliche Fahrt, Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1, Tchaikovsky - Six Romances, Kohji - Georgian, Mingrelian Songs, Weinberg - Rhapsody on Moldavian Themes Op. 47 and Wong - As the Heart Soars.

programme.title: Bach - The Well-Tempered Clavier Book 1 No.1 to 12
programme.desc: The Well-Tempered Clavier, BWV 846-893, is a collection of two series of Preludes and Fugues in all 24 major and minor keys, composed for solo keyboard by Bach. In this broadcast, Andrei Gavrilov plays Preludes and Fugues No. 1 to 12 (BWV 846-857). In 1722, when Johann Sebastian Bach lived in Köthen, Germany, he published a book of preludes and fugues in all 24 major and minor keys. This collection became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book One, BWV 846-869. About two decades later, Bach compiled a second book in Leipzig, which became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book Two, BWV 870-893. Bach intended these pieces for the clavier, which includes the harpsichord, clavichord, and organ. Despite this unclarity, these pieces are regarded as some of the most important works in the history of Western classical music. In this broadcast, Andrei Gavrilov plays Preludes and Fugues Nos. 1 to 12 (BWV 846-857) from Book One of Bach’s Well-Tempered Clavier, recorded at the New Art Gallery in Walsall, England, in 2010.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 6 BWV 1019
programme.desc: Frank Peter Zimmermann (violin), Enrico Pace (piano) This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No.6 BWV 1019 is the last of the set of sonatas that Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably while working as chapel master in Köthen. He presumably wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig. Maybe this is why these pieces are well playable for amateurs, while every sonata still has the finesse that can offer a challenge to professional musicians. The different pieces are meant to be a set, just like the Brandenburg concertos, but this last sonata is different from the others in that it has five sections instead of four.

programme.title: Memory of a Concert

The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. In 2006, Gidon Kremer and Martha Argerich set out on tour performing solos and duets by Bartók und Schumann. The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. A concert film with personal and moving commentary by Gidon Kremer. Program: Schumann's Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 10, Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 121; Kinderszenen, Op. 15; Bartók: Violin Sonata No. 1 Sz 75; Violin sonata No. 2 Sz 76.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final II: Mozart and Bartók
programme.desc: The first edition of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM) was dedicated to the piano. Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Gabriele Strata
programme.desc: Pianist Gabriele Strata (Italy, 1999) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai - Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM). It was recorded at the Bourgie Hall of the Montreal Museum of Fine Arts.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Pictures at an Exhibition - VII
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello). The work is the only concerto which Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. The concert closes with Ravel's beloved orchestration of Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition.

programme.title: The Boy with the Wig: Kids on Mozart
programme.desc: In this 30-minute film, children have their say; boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recount Mozart's life in their own words. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children. The Boy with the Wig - Kids on Mozart explores children’s fascination with the composer. The 30-minute film by Claus Wischmann features boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recounting his life through humour and serious interpretations of Mozart’s biography. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student. Inspired on the composer’s unrequited love for Irish actress Harriet Smithson, the five-movement piece portrays the dreams of a young artist who has taken an overdose of opium in the aftermath of a failed love affair. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. This broadcast featuring the three finalists’ best performances from the competition’s 26th edition, were recorded at the Villa Reale di Monza in October 2022. The finalists are Young Sun Choi (South Korea, 1991), Seunghyuk Na (South Korea, 1997), and Ivan Bašić (Serbia, 1996). The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. Founded in 1947 by Monza-born pianist Rina Sala Gallo and Brescia-born pianist Arturo Benedetti Michelangeli, the competition is one of Monza’s most prestigious cultural events today. This broadcast featuring the three finalists’ best performances from the competition’s 26th edition, were recorded at the Villa Reale di Monza in October 2022. First, Young Sun Choi (South Korea, 1991) performs Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 30 in E major, Op. 106. After, Seunghyuk Na (South Korea, 1997) plays ‘Oiseaux tristes’ and ‘Alborada del gracioso’ from Maurice Ravel’s five-movement suite Miroirs. Next, Ivan Bašić (Serbia, 1996) performs Franz Liszt’s Mephisto Waltz No. 1. Lastly, Choi returns for a performance of Claude Debussy’s Images (Book I).

programme.title: Brahms - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: Europakonzert 2004 was held in Athens, Greece. This concert featured the Berliner Philharmoniker performing live at the ancient Herodes Atticus Theatre along with an interesting combination of conductor and soloist. Europakonzert 2004 was held in Athens, Greece. This concert featured the Berliner Philharmoniker performing live at the ancient Herodes Atticus Theatre along with an interesting combination of conductor and soloist - Sir Simon Rattle wielding the baton as pianist Daniel Barenboim plays Johannes Brahms’ Piano Concerto No. 1. The Athens concert marked a double première: it was the first Europakonzert under the direction of the new chief conductor, as well as the first time Rattle and Barenboim appeared together. The Odeon of Herodes Atticus, an amphitheatre built in 161 AD in memory of Herodes Atticus’ wife, is situated on the slope of the Acropolis. With a seating capacity of at least 5,000 spectators, it was reputed to be the finest theatre in all of Greece.

programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021. programme.title: Naples, City of Keyboards - Gaetano Greco
programme.desc: Before Porpora, Scarlatti and Pergolesi ruled the Neapolitan music scene there was Gaetano Greco, one of the finest music teachers and composers of his day. Andrea Buccarella, a young harpsichordist from Rome (also performing in the Festival with his Abchordis Ensemble), pairs Greco’s most beautiful toccatas and famous Ballo di Mantua with works by his pupil Durante, who with his ‘quattro stagioni’ explores every nook and cranny of the keyboard. programme.title: House of Dreams
programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. It is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music by Bach and Handel. The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, who specialize in historical performance is directed by Jeanne Lamon. House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. The concert is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music - five European homes where exquisite works by Bach, Handel, Vivaldi, Purcell and Marais were played against a backdrop of paintings by Vermeer, Canaletto, and Watteau. Stage direction by Marshall Pynkoski and narrated by Blair Williams. The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The orchestra was founded in 1979 and has 19 full-time members who specialize in historical performance and technique, with additional musicians joining the ensemble when required. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon.

programme.title: Arvo Pärt - Kanon Pokajanen
programme.desc: Arvo Pärt based his ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ (from ‘Canon of Repentance to Our Lord Jesus Christ’, 1995-97) on the canon of repentance as handed down in the earliest Slavic-Christian manuscripts, dating back to the sixth century after Christ. Performed by the Aquarius Choir led by Michael de Smet in 2008. Arvo Pärt based his ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ (from ‘Canon of Repentance to Our Lord Jesus Christ’, 1995-97) on the canon of repentance as handed down in the earliest Slavic-Christian manuscripts, dating back to the sixth century after Christ. The canon symbolizes the change, the transformation from day to night, the Old and New Testament, prophecy and the fulfillment, the here and now and the hereafter. This deals with the human and the divine, weakness and strength, suffering and redemption, mortality and immortality. In this broadcast, ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ is performed by the chamber choir Aquarius. This Flemish chamber choir is a trailblazer where new music and new concert formats are concerned. ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ is a great example of this: the singers are positioned in a circle in the center of a church. This dark church is only lit by candles and the music stand lights. After the choir has entered in procession, they sing for close to two hours. Performed by the Aquarius Choir led by Michael de Smet in 2008.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2013 - Prague
programme.desc: The Europakonzert 2013 was celebrated at the Prague Castle at the historical Spanish Hall. Conductor: Sir Simon Rattle. Soloist: Magdalena Kozená. Works: Williams - Fantasia on a Theme by Thomas Tallis, Dvořák - Ten Biblical Songs, Beethoven - Symphony No. 6. Every year since 1991, the Berliner Philharmoniker has given concerts in a different European city on each May 1st. These concerts have become known as ‘Europakonzert’. Every guest city has its own special cultural importance. These concerts have served two purposes: to commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra’s founding on May 1st, 1882, and to celebrate the common heritage of the Old World. In 1991, soon after the opening of the Eastern European countries, the first Europakonzert took place in the Czech Republic in Prague. This decision was a deliberate step and an expression of willingness to support and to bring forward the democratization and the political social changes, especially in the cultural area. In 1996 the Europakonzert took place once again in Prague (at the National Theatre). To continue this tradition the Europakonzert 2013 was celebrated at the Prague Castle at the historical Spanish Hall. Conductor: Sir Simon Rattle. Soloist: Magdalena Kozená. Works: Ralph Vaughan Williams, Fantasia on a Theme by Thomas Tallis, Antonín Dvořák, Ten Biblical Songs, Opus 99. Ludwig van Beethoven, Symphony No. 6 in F Major, Op. 68.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 Heroic, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Summertime at the Domaine Forget
programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Discover this annual summer festival that celebrates music and dance. The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Domaine Forget is one of Canada's leading music academies and hosts this annual festival to promote music and dance. Every summer, 500 music students from around the world gather for an intensive course program featuring: masterclasses, individual lessons, chamber music sessions, lectures, and special workshops.

programme.title: Dvořák - Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8)
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020. Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvořák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvořák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s on Old Street in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Nutcracker 2011
programme.desc: This stunning performance, filmed live in Cape Town, South Africa in 2011, with Tchaikovsky's music performed by the Manchester Symphony Orchestra under the baton of Tim A. Duncan, shows the true skill and beauty of the art form of Ice Dance. This stunning performance of theatrical ice dancing brings viewers into the enchanting world of Tchaikovsky's magnificent holiday classic, The Nutcracker On Ice, performed by the internationally renowned Imperial Ice Stars, and including former champion figure skaters, Vadim Yarkov and Olga Sharutenko. This very special performance and soundtrack was performed by the Manchester Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Tim A. Duncan, and filmed live in Cape Town, South Africa in 2011.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2012. Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Admiring the ideals of the French Revolution, Beethoven initially dedicated the symphony to Napoleon Bonaparte. However, upon hearing that Napoleon had crowned himself Emperor, Beethoven violently erased Napoleon’s name from the manuscript. Composed in 1803-04 in a style that breaks with tradition, the symphony is regarded as a turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony. The work opens with two powerful chords that replace the more customary long introduction. The lower strings then introduce the main theme. The slow second movement is a Funeral March, followed by a quick Scherzo. The fourth and final movement is dominated by a theme from Beethoven’s ballet music for ‘The Creatures of Prometheus’. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2012.

programme.title: Mexican Concert - Part I
programme.desc: Anabel de la Mora is accompanied by the Orquesta Sinfonica de Minería conducted by Raúl Delgado in a concert program dedicated to Mexican composers. Recorded at the Academia de Música del Palacio de Minería, Mexico City in 2019. Soprano Anabel de la Mora is accompanied by the Orquesta Sinfonica de Minería conducted by Raúl Delgado in a concert program dedicated to Mexican composers. This program, which includes the first part of the concert, features the following works: Miguel Bernal Jiménez's "Angelus", Alfonso Esparza's "Dime que sí", María Grever's "Munequita Lina", Ricardo Castro's "Intermezzo de Atzimba", Jorge del Moral's "Besos robados", and Consuelo Velázquez's "Bésame mucho". This concert was recorded at the Academia de Música del Palacio de Minería in Mexico City in 2019.

programme.title: Handel - Agrippina
programme.desc: Agrippina is a fresh, exuberantly inventive opera and sets one of the finest librettos Handel has worked with. It was duly recorded under the baton of Arnold Östman, a renowned specialist in music of the 17th and 18th centuries. Schwetzingen, a small German town near Heidelberg, boasts a famous palace with gardens as magnificent as those at Versailles. In the spring, the palace is the backdrop for the Schwetzingen Festival. Every year, the festival commissions a small-scale opera for the palace's exquisite Rococo theatre, built in 1752. Agrippina is a brilliant early George Frideric Handel opera. Composed when he was just twenty-four, it was Handel's first big hit in the theater. It’s full of his fresh, exuberantly inventive music, and set to a libretto by Cardinal Vincenzo Grimani, one of the finest librettists Handel ever worked with. This staging of Agrippina was recorded under the baton of Arnold Östman, a renowned specialist in the music of the 17th and 18th centuries. The London Baroque Players accompany Barbara Daniels, Janice Hall, and David Kuebler in Michael Hampe's elegant and colourful production that shows us the perfidious intrigues of the power-crazy Empress Agrippina, and the criminal power struggles in classical Rome.

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Crtana serija "Barbapapa" fokusira se na svakodnevne živote članova obitelji Barbapapa, bića koja mijenjaju oblik. Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet
programme.desc: 'Bibin čarobni svijet' je čudnovati animirani svijet za djecu predškolske dobi, koja kroz zabavne nastavke otkrivaju prirodu, uče kako se lijepo ponašati i stvaraju zdrave navike. U uzbudljivim pustolovinama, Bibi i njezino društvo, koje čine znatiželjni prijatelj Bobby i njihovi izvanzemaljski prijatelji Zazzy i Zina, istražuju začaranu šumu, rješavaju misterije i uče važne životne pouke.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
programme.desc: Kada ambiciozni duelist Yuma upozna Astral, tajanstvenog posjetitelja iz drugog svemira, čini se kao sudbina. Yuma treba Astrala da ga nauči kako da se dvoboji, a Astral treba Yumu da mu pomogne povratiti sjećanja! Oni bi bili najveći tag tim dvoboja... osim što se ne slažu! Ovaj duel bolje da se brzo spoji jer ZEXAL je potpuno novi dvoboj s većim izazovima nego ikad prije! Fantastična nova čudovišta! Snažne nove karte! Tehnologija dvoboja s proširenom stvarnošću! Zajedno, dvoboj ide na sljedeću razinu! Ali ne brinite ako nikada prije niste bili u dvoboju: Dok Astral prolazi Yumom kroz osnove, novi gledatelji mogu pratiti i naučiti kako se natjecati. A za iskusne profesionalce, postoji mnogo nikad viđenih strategija koje se mogu koristiti u stvarnom životu! Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL - Nova pravila, novi dvoboji!

Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet
programme.desc: 'Bibin čarobni svijet' je čudnovati animirani svijet za djecu predškolske dobi, koja kroz zabavne nastavke otkrivaju prirodu, uče kako se lijepo ponašati i stvaraju zdrave navike. U uzbudljivim pustolovinama, Bibi i njezino društvo, koje čine znatiželjni prijatelj Bobby i njihovi izvanzemaljski prijatelji Zazzy i Zina, istražuju začaranu šumu, rješavaju misterije i uče važne životne pouke.

programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: Milionski auditorijum sa teritorije cele Srbije, svih starosnih i socijalnih kategorija svoj dan počinje uz "Novo jutro". Pored najpopularnijih voditeljskih tandema, gledaoci tokom cele radnje nedelje ostaju uz naše jutro zahvaljujući pravovremenom i aktuelnom izveštavanju kroz neizostavne rubrike: "Prelistavanje dnevne štampe", "Tema jutra", "(Ne)zapaženo" i mnoge druge. Zaštitni znak "Novog jutra" su i uključenja iz cele Srbije, ali i Beograda zahvaljujući autentičnom Filipu Maksimoviću i uvek nasmejanom Milanu Raoniću, uz koje ćemo i ovu sezonu početi u vrhu top liste gledanosti.

programme.title: Premijera
programme.desc: Aktuelno, premijerno, za korak ispred svih - Premijera je zbog toga najgledanija kratka forma vesti o poznatima. Ne postoji javna ličnost do koje premijerna ekipa ne može doći, a nijedan gradski događaj ne može proći bez njih. I u novoj sezoni najveće domaće i regionalne zvezde govoriće pred Premijerinim kamerama, ali kroz nove rubrike: Ličnost dana, VIP online, Sa beogradskih ulica i Ispred premijernog objektiva.

programme.title: Ekskluzivno
programme.desc: Za razliku od većine sličnih formata, ekipa emisije Ekskluzivno ima drugačiji pristup poznatim ličnostima. Direktno i bez uvijanja, sva ona pitanja koja drugi ne smeju da pitaju, postavljaju novinari emisije Ekskluzivno i donose priče o poznatima iz drugog ugla.

programme.title: Oteta, serija
programme.desc: Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savesti... Orhun je uspešan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao lekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu devojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog detinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsednuta je "čistom krvlju". Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: Klopka ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Mračna kletva „visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice.Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu.Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika.Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

programme.title: Odbačena, serija
programme.desc: Reč je o životnoj avanturi devojčice po imenu Melisa Celik, koja je kao beba ostala bez roditelja, a koja je ostala u sirotištu. Niko ne zna istinu o tome šta se desilo njenoj porodici. Melisa pokušava da ostane sa porodicom koja ju je usvojila, ali Besime, domaćica, ne želi Melisu i podvrgava je raznim mučenjima. Jednog dana, kada je kao žrtvu gneva stave na vrata, pred njom se pojavljuje muškarac, Metin. Tada počinju da pričaju, nesvesni da će im se život od tog trenutka potpuno promeniti.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Zejnep je oličenje gracioznosti i inteligencije, kojoj se svi dive. Ipak, ona ima skriveni ratnički duh. Halil, mlad bez roditelja i opterećen tugom, suočio se sa životnim nedaćama. Njihovi putevi se prepliću - Zejnep, slobodnog duha ispod svoje staložene spoljašnjosti, i Halil, odan porodici. Zajedno u vrtlogu ljubavi, oni nalaze da su njihove sudbine neraskidivo povezane. Dok se kreću putem prepunom izbora i posledica, ostaje pitanje: može li njihova ljubav izdržati izazove sa kojima se suočavaju?

programme.title: Ajvar, film
programme.desc: Vida i Bane imućan su bračni par iz Srbije koji već dugo živi u Stockholmu. Posvećeni karijerama, nemaju djecu, a u Srbiju se vraćaju tek ljeti i praznicima. Vida vjeruje da Bane u Beogradu ima ljubavnicu, no tu sumnju čuva za sebe. Dolazi Uskrs i njih dvoje putuje u Srbiju kako bi provelo blagdan s obitelji. No ovaj put nešto je drukčije. Njihova pažljivo uigrana koreografija počinje se raspadati i zid šutnje napokon se ruši. Ajvar je priča o odlasku, životu u emigraciji i anatomiji jednoga kraja. I o teglici ajvara koja služi kao sidro između dvaju svjetova. Za ulogu u filmu Nataša Ninković nagrađena je Zlatnom mimozom za najbolju glumicu na Festivalu Herceg Novi.

programme.title: Seljaci, serija
programme.desc: Serija "Seljaci" je saga o nekoliko seoskih porodica koje žive u našem selu Treskavica, a čiji su mnogi članovi rasuti po svetu od Pariza do Novog Zelanda. Dolazi do mešanja starih i novih običaja i navika, što je izvor mnogih konfliktnih i komičnih situacija. Zašto gledaoci vole da gledaju seriju "Seljaci"? Zato što je autentična, naša, što sa blagom ironijom i humorom govori o našim manama i lošim navikama, a sa velikom simpatijom o našim tradicionalnim vrednostima...

programme.title: Ljubav navika panika, serija
programme.desc: Brak je kada dvoje ljudi zajedno rešavaju probleme koje nikad ne bi imali da nisu zajedno...oni se stalno svađaju, ali ne bi valjalo da je drugačije...oni su razdvojeni, ali žive u istom stanu... oni su srećni u svađama, neverovatni u neurozi i nemoćni da smisle argument za svoje ili tuđe ponašanje... kada ljubav postane navika da li sve postaje panika.....

programme.title: Trenutak iz sna
programme.desc: Nova sezona „Trenutak iz sna donosi priče žena čiji fizički izgled svedoči o decenijama stresa, tuge, teškog fizičkog rada i trauma. Njihov fizički izgled odražava godine skrivanja od pogleda drugih iz straha da ne budu osuđene, a svaki pogled u ogledalo ih podseća na njihove unutrašnje borbe, svaki susret sa ljudima ih suočava sa osećajem srama i odbačenosti. Kroz suze, bol i odlučnost pronašle su put ka svetlu. Njihove priče su izuzetne, njihova hrabrost nadmašuje granice mogućeg, a njihova transformacija je inspiracija za sve. Tim vrhunskih stručnjaka učiniće sve da ove žene podignu iz pepela, obnove njihovu veru u sebe i pronađu unutrašnju snagu. Hirurzi i anti-aging eksperti kombinovali su svoje svoje veštine kako bi obnovili, pomladili kožu i uklonili mnoge fizičke nedostatke, pomažući ženama da povrate svežinu i vitalnost. Stomatolozi stvaraju blistav osmeh koji zrači samopouzdanjem i zdravljem. Psiholozi pružaju emocionalnu podršku i pomažu ženama da prevaziđu unutrašnje izazove, prebrode prošlost i pronađu mir. Frizeri, šminkeri i stilisti brižljivo oblikuju izgled, naglašavajući individualnu lepotu i autentičnost svake žene. Svaka transformacija je poput čuda koje se odigrava pred našim očima. U serijalu „Trenutak iz sna, ove izuzetne žene donose hrabru odluku da se odvoje od svojih najbližih dok traje njihova transformacija. A onda, kao najlepša nagrada za hrabrost koju su pokazale, na samom velikom finalu čeka ih porodica koja ih nakon nekoliko nedelja po prvi put vidi u potpuno novom izdanju. Trenutak kada se ponovno sretnu sa svojim voljenima je pravi trenutak iz sna, jer je obasjan osmesima, suzama radosnicama, neprocenjivim zagrljajima i nevericom.Ovaj serijal nije samo priča o transformaciji, već i o ljubavi, hrabrosti, podršci i ljudskosti koju dugujemo jedni drugima. „Trenutak iz sna je prilika da kroz svaku epizodu proživite emotivno putovanje, zato ne propustite novu sezonu, svakog četvrtka u 22 časa na televiziji Pink.

programme.title: SCENA
programme.desc: Emisija se bavi aktuelnim dešavanjima iz života poznatih, prati bitne događaje na domaćoj javnoj sceni i donosi pregršt zanimljivih vijesti, intervjua i izveštaja o poznatima. Za ovu zabavnu emisiju o poznatima govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvijezde, a čine je i aktuealne vijesti iz svijeta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije SCENA REGION donosi sve važne vijesti iz života poznatih i prati sve najznačajnije događaje, ne samo u zemlji, već i u regionu.

programme.title: Kuća od srca
programme.desc: Iz kreativne kuhinje produkcijske kuće "Shadow production" dolazi nova sezona najhumanijeg TV serijala "Kuća od srca". Najdramatičnija sezona do sada donosi snažne priče o ljudima koji su se našli na ivici egzistencije. Oni nemaju dom kakav zaslužuju, a zbog neadekvatnih uslova koji prete da ugroze živote i zdravlje porodice, najviše ispaštaju deca. Usled susreta sa surovim udarcima života deca mogu da izgube pravo na svoje detinjstvo. Urušeni plafoni i zidovi puni vlage svedoče o tome da su ove porodice za dlaku izbegle smrt. Njihove sudbine su neizvesne, a potresne ispovesti ostaviće gledaoce bez daha.

programme.title: Šifra Despot
programme.desc: "Šifra Despot" je elegična socijalna komedija naravi i mentaliteta, smeštena u ambijent metropole, ali podjednako i u autentična srpska predgrađa, varošice, gradove, sela i zaseoke. Ne napuštajući ni jednog trenutka životne vratolomije glavnog junaka serije, pomalo nespretnog i taličnog, ali veoma talentovanog kompjuterskog programera Despota Despotovića, kog igra mladi glumac Đorđe Marković, serija će u tematskom, vizuelnom i socijalnom smislu oslikati vreme u kom živimo. Nastojanje glavnog lika da preživi i da obezbedi sopstvenu egzistenciju kao jedini zaposleni u svojoj softverskoj kući "Despot & Co", u svakoj od 45 epizoda prve sezone, vodiće njega i gledaoce serije na najrazličitije lokacije i socijalne sredine - na farmu ćuraka, u fitnis centar, bolnice, fabrike, advokatske kancelarije, u nevladine organizacije, političke partije, staračke domove, sportske klubove, kladionice, banke, škole plesa, modne salone i mnoga druga mesta - što predstavlja izvanredan dramaturški i scenaristički okvir za razvoj komediografskih odnosa, kojim će pored društveno odgovorih tema, koje će serija tretirati, gledaoci biti u prilici da se zabave, relaksiraju uz zdrav i nepatvoreni humor na temljima srpskog mentaliteta - koji autor Radoš Bajić izvanredno dobro poznaje.

programme.title: Oteta, serija
programme.desc: Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savesti... Orhun je uspešan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao lekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu devojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog detinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsednuta je "čistom krvlju". Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: Nasledstvo
programme.desc: Dve žene koje se nikada u životu nisu srele otrovane su istim otrovom, istoga dana. Jedna je devedesetogodišnja vlasnica predratnog hotela Pariz u kojem je vreme stalo, a druga je sekretarica tajkuna koji pokušava da se domogne hotela u centru grada, kako bi na njegovom mestu izgradio najveći tržni centar na Balkanu. Ko je ubica dve žene, a ko neverovatni naslednik hotela i celokupne imovine ubijene vlasnice? U mnogobrojnim obrtima, u vrtlogu para i ljubavi, odanosti i izdaje, iskrenosti i podlosti, sveta siromašnih i sveta bogatih, poštenja i lopovluka, časti i pohlepe, skromnosti i snobovštine, sukoba generacija, porodičnih lomova i društvenih previranja - lome se i sudbine čak i onih koji u tome nisu želeli da učestvuju.

programme.title: Kad na vrbi rodi grožđe, serija
programme.desc: Serija se po malo, a nekada i malo više, podsmeva bahatostima, mitomaniji, primitvluku, glupostima i besmislicama na koje, naši junaci svoga mentaliteta radi, najčešće, život utrošiše...Ova serija govori o naravima građana malog mesta, negde na Balkanu. Oni se međusobno prepiru, nekada i posvade, često zavole, a i razilaze...ali su jedni na druge upućeni, i jedni bez drugih ne mogu. Postoje trenuci kada je nekome od njih teško, kada se desi prirodno zlo, često radost, a i žalost, oni se okupljaju jedni oko drugih, pomažu, tu su da se nađu i da učine što mogu. Oni su komšije, bez obzira na ime, veru i naciju...

programme.title: Villa Maria, serija
programme.desc: Porodici Jurak nacionalizovan je veći deo imovine nakon Drugog svetskog rata, ali svejedno nisu ostali siromašni. Stanuju u dobrom zagrebačkom kvartu. Tomislav Jurak (Žarko Radić) je pedesetogodišnjak, vodi porodični biznis koji uključuje lanac restorana i hotel u centru grada, koji je počeo da gradi još u vreme socijalizma, ali ga je u vlasništvo preuzeo tokom privatizacije devedesetih novcem svoje tete Mitzy. Njegova žena Ana Jurak (Ksenija Pajić), u ranim četrdesetim, rodila mu je dvoje dece- Ivana i Doru. Ana je napustila studije prava kad ga je upoznala i posvetila se brizi o porodici i uz pomoć kućne pomoćnice, brizi o samoj sebi-shopping, bazen i tračanje, omiljene su joj obaveze. Kako god bilo, ona je u svakom slučaju temelj familije. Ćerka Dora (Jelena Veljača) ima 20 godina i studira ekonomiju. Otac je obožava i ne prihvata činjenicu da je već odavno došla u godine da ima dečka i svoju intimu. Razmažena tatina kćer. Ivan (Mislav Čavajda) radi s ocem u firmi. Zgodan zagrebački dečko, dvadesetpetogodišnjak, ali neodgovoran, sklon porocima, ukratko, loš karakter lepog lica. S druge strane, nalazi se porodica bankara Maksa Lovreka (Ante Čedo Martinić), koji Jurakovoj firmi daje veliki kredit za preuzimanje malotrgovinskog lanca. On i Tomislav Jurak (ne)prijatelji su još od falultetskih dana. Uz posao, Jurakovi i Lovrekovi povezani su i privatno, a razdoblje prividnog prijateljstva s početka priče ubrzo prerasta u suparništvo. Max Lovrek oženjen je Vesnom Lovrek (Barbara Vicković), ženom sumnjivog karaktera, koja je pritom Maksu neverna. Bankar Lovrek iz prvog braka ima sina Svena (Sven Madžarević), 2o godišnjaka, prilično povučenog, skromnog dečka. Maks kuje zaveru protiv Juraka s Jurakovim ambicioznim sinom Ivanom. Treća glavna ekipa su bolesna majka Dunja (Nada Gačešić Livaković) i njen sin Luka (Damir Markovina), pametan i obrazovan mladić koji neumorno radi kod Jurakovih, ali ne razume da ga oni iskorištavaju. Ima i razloga za slepilo: voli Jurakovu ćerku, Doru. Njihovu vezu Tomislav Jurak nikad ne bi dopustio...

programme.title: Crveni mesec, serija
programme.desc: Ljubavna, ali i snažna istorijska priča, smeštena je u period od avgusta 1913, nakon pobede Srbije u Balkanskim ratovima kada je povratila deo teoritorije, do kraja 1915. godine, kada je austrougarska vojska okupirala Beograd. Glavni junak, mladi srpski oficir koga tumači Miloš Đurović, vraća se sa ratišta u rodnu kuću. Svadba mu je, tradicionalno, već zakazana, ali zaplet priče počinje kada se ćerka austrougarskog poslanika, koju igra Ivana Dudić, zainteresuje za njega. Nedopustivo za to vreme, koketna mlada dama, ne krije svoja osećanja prema mladom oficiru. Rasplet njihove ljubavne drame,koja je plod mašte autora, odvija se u realnom istorijskom periodu pred Veliki rat, pa se u scenariju pojavljuje još dvadesetak glavnih likova, uglavnom stvarnih istorijskih ličnosti. Ovo ostvarenje obiluje dramatičnim događajima, špijunskim intrigama, diplomatskim nadmudrivanjima, političkim spletkama i prevarama...

programme.title: Tahiti Pearl Regatta, 2017
programme.desc: To organize a yearly sailing party in the Leeward Islands of French Polynesia: that was the dream of the newly born Raiatea Regatta Association. Since then, the TPR has become the biggest sailing and festive regatta of the Pacific islands and a truly international nautical event.Over the years, the TPR has become the most beautifun regatta of the Pacific island, attracting international crews each year in search of an extraordinary experience. In a warm and authentic atmosphere, the TPR takes place in lagoons with captivating colours, festive stops on islands or motu (islets along the coral reef) and with the sound of the Polynesian winds.The itinerary changes each year, discovering new islands of Raiatea, but what never changes is the fun and beautiful scenery characteristic of this unique regatta.

programme.title: VOR Identity
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race visits 10 cities around the world making it the ultimate test for sailors around the world. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s Big Three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.However, to truly understand the race, it is better to think about the athletes who take part of it. Meet the teams and the superstars in Alicante on the eve of their quest to the Volvo Ocean Race. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win.Map the racecourse, get the latest intel on the boats and the tech and above all, find out what really moves the action of heroes from modern day offshore sailing. Watch it now, on Nautical Channel and become part of this sailing frenzy.

programme.title: Reaching Reality, 1 - - Origin
programme.desc: From under the Golden Gate Bridge down to the Santa Cruz Islands the three friends and their little boat are now heading south. However bad weather is on the horizon and signs that the film and the filmmaker are already thinking about abandoning ship are starting to leak through. After a long night of sea sickness, it’s time to face reality and see who’s going to stick around and who’s going to go.

programme.title: Reaching Reality, 1 - - Reality
programme.desc: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Kite Masters is a series showcasing the latest news from the inspirational world of kite boarding - the action packed sport which continues to take the world by storm. Whether you are a kiteboarder - competitor or recreational, kiteboarding fan, interested observer or have ever wanted to give kiteboarding a go, then you are guaranteed to enjoy the Kite Masters series. There are a myriad of different disciplines in kiteboarding - racing to freestyle - for weekend warriors and the professional riders. Kite Masters checks in on them all and brings you the best round up of action from around the world.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The island of Rab has a rich history and has been inhabited by numerous great personalities. The Romans named this place Felix Arba or Lucky, which actually means Happy island. With 30 sandy beaches, Rab is truly a happy island and its beauty has been recognized by tourists from around the world for almost 125 years.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Hello Sailors! It’s such a great pleasure to welcome you to the new season of Sail-ho Croatia. We’re setting off on yet another incredible journey sailing the Adriatic starting from the lush and picturesque Neretva valley and the town of Ploče. Stay tuned and enjoy the ride!

programme.title: Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Big wave surfer Andrew Cotton, a plumber and father of two from Devon, hit the headlines in 2014 when it was rumoured that he had surfed the world’s biggest wave, estimated at 80ft. In this one-off 30-minute documentary, Andrew and his team of surfers, sailors and adventurers put everything on hold as they secretly chase a wave that emerges only a handful of times each year, giving only hours of warning.Taking a boat eight miles off the coast of Ireland, the team battle the extreme cold and fierce weather conditions, whilst mapping the ocean’s swell, in order to try to catch one almighty ride. Far from home and with the days getting shorter, frustration sets in, as the window of opportunity gets smaller. With a young family at home, Andrew must balance the normality of the school run, before boarding a plane alone to face one of earth’s deadliest monsters.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup, 2019 - Slalom 3 World Cup Tacen
programme.desc: We are in stage three of the Canoe Slalom World Cup, and this time we will be competing on the water of Ljubljana, in Tacen. The racing conditions are perfect and we are focused on the final: men will be competing in C1 and women in K1. Matej Benus who was leading the standings in the men's category will not be competing in the final, so Benjamin Savsek has a chance to step up in the podium. Relive the best moments of the third stage of the 2018 Canoe Slalom World Cup in Tacen.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: 2019 - Slalom 4 World Cup Markkleeberg We are in Markkleeberg, Germany, for round four of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. This is the third time this venue hosts a World Cup, and 183 athletes from 26 countries have enrolled, competing for points across the five-race World Cup. As we are a month away from the olympic qualifiers and World Championships in Spain, we are ready for a sharp end of the 2019 international racing season. Discover the best moments in Markkleeberg on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: 2022 - : Novalja, NP Plitvička jezera, Rijeka, Opatija Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​ If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: Inside Kiel - Sailing Capital and more
programme.desc: Kiel is the nautical epicentre of Germany, and the proud host of the world's biggest sailing event, the Kieler Woche. From learning how to sail a Formula18 catamaran to exploring local kitesurf spots and shipyards, Nautical Channel host Lucia Metzbauer will be there, diving into the local nautical scene and finding out why there are so many young sailors in Kiel.Join her in Kieler Woche, one of the largest sailing events in the world. With regattas sailing at the highest level and an unbeatable class diversity, entertainment is secured as we learn everything about this German event that drives the attention of sailors worldwide.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship, 2025 - - GP of China - Zhengzhou
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: 2024 - GP of Binh Dinh (Vietnam Ski) After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.desc: Kiel is the nautical epicentre of Germany, and the proud host of the world's biggest sailing event, the Kieler Woche. From learning how to sail a Formula18 catamaran to exploring local kitesurf spots and shipyards, Nautical Channel host Lucia Metzbauer will be there, diving into the local nautical scene and finding out why there are so many young sailors in Kiel.Join her in Kieler Woche, one of the largest sailing events in the world. With regattas sailing at the highest level and an unbeatable class diversity, entertainment is secured as we learn everything about this German event that drives the attention of sailors worldwide.

programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: The Dangerous Waters crewmembers will ride an epic adventure like no other on their JetSki. Their world-first adventure is plagued with wildlife, wicked waters, tropical storms and new unknown challenges they will have to overcome. As the conditions worsen, crewmembers are forced to drastically take decisions in an environment where not all will get to their final destination.Become part of the crew as they battle the elements on their JetSkis, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: 2025 - - GP of Sharjah - United Arab Emirates After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: 2024 - GP of Binh Dinh (Vietnam Runabout & Freestyle) After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Jet Ski World Series, 2023 - Round 4 - Thailand
programme.desc: Put your helmets on because we are getting started with the Jet Ski World Series! Delivering whooping speeds of 100km/hr in under 3.8 seconds and with 500 horsepower, riders need to be sharp to turn 30 degrees at 140 km/h, putting the 'Jet' in Jet Ski. Wearing no protective body, grappling with the waves and fighting out with gravity, the riders that dare challenge this competition are some of the most corageous athletes in the world. Are you going to miss out? Tune up to the latest edition of the Jet Ski World Series!

programme.title: Reaching Reality, 1 - - Origin
programme.desc: From under the Golden Gate Bridge down to the Santa Cruz Islands the three friends and their little boat are now heading south. However bad weather is on the horizon and signs that the film and the filmmaker are already thinking about abandoning ship are starting to leak through. After a long night of sea sickness, it’s time to face reality and see who’s going to stick around and who’s going to go.

programme.title: Reaching Reality, 1 - - Reality
programme.desc: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Big wave surfer Andrew Cotton, a plumber and father of two from Devon, hit the headlines in 2014 when it was rumoured that he had surfed the world’s biggest wave, estimated at 80ft. In this one-off 30-minute documentary, Andrew and his team of surfers, sailors and adventurers put everything on hold as they secretly chase a wave that emerges only a handful of times each year, giving only hours of warning.Taking a boat eight miles off the coast of Ireland, the team battle the extreme cold and fierce weather conditions, whilst mapping the ocean’s swell, in order to try to catch one almighty ride. Far from home and with the days getting shorter, frustration sets in, as the window of opportunity gets smaller. With a young family at home, Andrew must balance the normality of the school run, before boarding a plane alone to face one of earth’s deadliest monsters.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The island of Rab has a rich history and has been inhabited by numerous great personalities. The Romans named this place Felix Arba or Lucky, which actually means Happy island. With 30 sandy beaches, Rab is truly a happy island and its beauty has been recognized by tourists from around the world for almost 125 years.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Hello Sailors! It’s such a great pleasure to welcome you to the new season of Sail-ho Croatia. We’re setting off on yet another incredible journey sailing the Adriatic starting from the lush and picturesque Neretva valley and the town of Ploče. Stay tuned and enjoy the ride!

programme.title: Ivkova slava, film
programme.desc: Gazda Ivko, njegova supruga i prijatelji Kalčo, Smuk i Kurjak slave Đurđevdan. Slavlje se po običaju rastegne duboko u noć, no ove godine, kada im se pridruži nepoznati mladić Svetislav,, društvo odluči produžiti svetkovinu na tri dana!

programme.title: Kvar, film
programme.desc: Novinar živi uhodanim građanskim životom, u braku sa ženom iz ugledne porodice. Međutim, ređaju se sukobi sa šefom na radnom mestu, brak se klima, a spoljna manifestacija svega je čudna kožna bolest. Lekari mu preporuče odmor u prirodi i preispitivanje samoga sebe. U planini, u usamljenoj kući kraj jezera, sretne jednu ženu, takođe neprilagođenu i usamljenu. Posledice ovog susreta su blagotvorne. Ponovo sposoban za ljubav, on stiče moralnu snagu, a i bolest se povlači. Raskida sa ženinom porodicom i malograđanštinom dotadašnjeg života, suprotstavlja se šefu i izlazi kao pobednik, svestan da je to tek prva pobeda koja ga je postavila na noge.

programme.title: Rani snijeg u Münchenu, film
programme.desc: Nakon 16 godina rada u Münchenu, gastarbajter Lovrić (P. Vuisić) namjerava se zajedno sa ženom (I. Marjanović) i sinom vratiti iz Njemačke u domovinu. Sin (D. Grgečić Gabor) je nezadovoljan očevom odlukom, njegova prava domovina zapravo je Njemačka. Sukob između njih dvojice doživljava vrhunac nakon što sin priopći Lovriću kako namjerava oženiti Njemicu Hannelore (U. Fiedler). Očajni Lovrić nikako se ne može pomiriti s činjenicom da ga sin ne želi slušati... Film je snimljen prema scenariju Gorana Massota (autor predloška za Golikovu 'Ljubicu').

programme.title: Stepenice za nebo, film
programme.desc: Sinopsis: Diplomirani arhitekt, tražeći posao napušta svoje malo mjesto pun ideja. Vraća se depresiran i razočaran i dalje tražeći posao. Pokuša se družiti sa svojim starim prijateljima, nadajući se da će mu oni pomoči naći sreću koju traži.

programme.title: Osveta, film
programme.desc: Četrdesetogodišnju Nadu, poslije petnaest godina provedenih na privremenom radu u Njemačkoj, napusti muž. On se vraća u domovinu, otvara automehaničarsku radionicu i s mladom ženom započinje novi život. Kako bi Nadi onemogućio povratak, širi priču o njenom raskalašenom životu. Ali Nada se vraća u čaršiju u Mercedesu i u pratnji mladog Nijemca. Kruže priče da će otvoriti veliki autoservis i tako uništiti bivšeg muža koji osjeća njenu želju za osvetom. Napušten od prijatelja i nove supruge, on odlući ubiti Nadu. U međuvremenu između Nade i Nijemca se rađa ljubav…

programme.title: Skoro sasvim obična priča, film
programme.desc: Poslije tri i pol godine - koliko su proveli zajedno - Irena i Vlada dolaze do prelomne točke svog odnosa u trenutku kada se poslije više od četiri godine u Beograd vraća Marija - djevojka s kojom je Vlada studirao i u koju je nekada bio zaljubljen. To je trenutak pravog ispita za ovu vezu koju karakterizira prije svega jedan inteligentan senzibilitet ovo dvoje mladih ljudi koji već polako zalaze u četvrto desetljeće života proživljenog kroz šarolik spektar nadrealnih, komičnih ali i vrlo osobnih melodramskih momenata. Sve njihove romantične nesporazume prate i komentiraju Vladin najbolji prijatelj, Bane, kao i Irenina najbliža prijateljica Anja, koji uredno nose i ključnu boju posebnog humora ove filmske priče ispričane u formi stalnih flešbekova i flešforvarda neodoljivih perspektiva.

programme.title: Zemaljski dani teku, film
programme.desc: Umirovljeni kapetan riječne plovidbe odluči da starost provede u domu za umirovljenike, vjerujući da je bolje da živi u društvu sebi sličnih, nego da pasivno čeka kraj. Svojim vedrim duhom on u domski život unosi čar novine i živost. Međutim, u sobi koju dijeli sa čovjekom sasvim različite prirode, taj novi duh nije naišao na dobrodošlicu. Počinju nesuglasice, u početku neznatne, a zatim sve veće, da bi dobile neočekivani epilog u proslavi novogodišnje noći.

programme.title: Put na jug, film
programme.desc: Tridesetogodišnjak se vraća iz Južne Amerike u rodno selo, na planinama Jugoslavije, da bi našao djevojku kojom će se oženiti. Odlučuje se za najmlađu kćer samohrane Židovke. Nju i još šest siromašnih djevojaka koje je namamio obećavši im bogatu udaju, zatvara u potpalublje broda koji plovi za Buenos Aires gdje ih namjerava zaposliti u javnim kućama.

programme.title: Put na jug, film
programme.desc: Tridesetogodišnjak se vraća iz Južne Amerike u rodno selo, na planinama Jugoslavije, da bi našao djevojku kojom će se oženiti. Odlučuje se za najmlađu kćer samohrane Židovke. programme.title: Jagode u grlu, film
programme.desc: Filmska priča ponovno okuplja stare školske prijatelje koji su sada, nakon 15 godina, situirani i odrasli ljudi, no ne nužno ozbiljni i savjesni. Stari se prijatelji nalaze povodom dolaska Mikija Rubiroze iz inozemstva. Bane Bumbar i njegova žena Biljka, Goca, Uške, Boca Čombe i Miki nalaze se na splavi zakupljenoj samo za njih. Uz sjećanje na mladost u vrijeme šezdesetih, prijatelji piju i jedu te sentimentalan sastanak i nostalgična sjećanja prerastu u turbulentnu noć svađa, rastava, mirenja, zamjeranja, igranja skrivača, a sve uz prateći band koji izvodi evergreene poput O sole mio, El condor pasa, O, mladosti (Arsen Dedić), Love Me Tender... Jagode u grlu (1985) svojevrstan je nastavak iznimno popularne serije iz 70-tih Grlom u jagode, koja je oduševljavala svojom duhovitošću, neposrednošću, sarkazmom te opisala lude 60-te na balkanskim prostorima. Tvorci su filma, kao i serije, eminentni filmaši: Srđan Karanović i Rajko Grlić. Režiju potpisuje Srđan Karanović, (Miris poljskog cveća, Petrijin venac) koji također s Rajkom Grlićem (Samo jednom se ljubi, U raljama života) supotpisuje i scenarij. U glavnim su ulogama poznati srpski glumci.

programme.title: Lavina, film
programme.desc: Prije godinu dana u švicarskim Alpama Franjo (Stojan Matavulj) je nestao u lavini. Proglašen je mrtvim te mu je organiziran sprovod na kojem ga oplakuju njegove dvije supruge, Lidija (Robert Ugrina) i Angelina (Ksenija Marinković), s kojima ima kćeri. No iznenada, Franjo se vraća iz mrtvih i to kao - homoseksualac. Povrh toga, s njim stiže i njegov novi dečko (Borko Perić), instruktor skijanja. Duhovita Lavina Stjepana Tomića na prvu će vam možda izgledati kao da je na humorni način preuzela koncept hororaca u kojima se mrtvi s drugog svijeta vraćaju sasvim drugačiji, no to ipak nije slučaj jer ovo je samo feel good film, čistokrvna komedija, koja se nema namjeru prodavati za išta drugo osim za ono što jest i što pruža, a to su lavine smijeha. Prema riječima Tomića, Lavina je u potpunosti nezavisan film nastao u privatnoj produkciji, financiran privatnim novcem i ostvaren entuzijazmom ekipe te oslobođen ograničenja koja nam nameću dobar ukus i zdrava pamet. Iako priča o homoseksualnosti, nije film koje drži prodike niti želi lamentirati o društevnim temama i stanju društva, već je prvenstveno simpatična, neopterećena komedija koja želi nasmijati i zabaviti, a to radi jako dobro.

programme.title: Beli lavovi, film
programme.desc: Beli lavovi je priča koja govori o ljudima, intelektualcima koji se teško snalaze u ovim teškim vremenima, pa su prinuđeni raditi poslove koje inače ne bi...

programme.title: Devojački most, film
programme.desc: Mjesto razmjene njemačkih zarobljenika i partizana zarobljenih od strane Nijemaca je Devojački most. Sa položaja kreće kolona mladih boraca i devet zarobljenih Nijemaca. Put do mosta je za mlade partizane dvostruko iskušenje: borilačko, jer sa svih strana vrebaju opasnosti, i etičko, jer se moraju izlagati riziku zbog neprijatelja koji je bio krajnje nemilosrdan.

Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan, Jazz
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville, Modern
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time. From David Bowie and Iggy Pop to Pink Floyd and Chet Baker, countless stars recorded unforgettable music here until the studio closed in the 1980s. Three decades later, Château d'Hérouville has reopened its doors. This program follows American singer-songwriter Melody Gardot as she visits the legendary studio. After an accident in 2003 left her hypersensitive to light and sound, Gardot discovered the healing power of music. At Hérouville, she gives an interview and plays a breathtaking live set. Her performance opens with a beautiful version of ‘Baby I’m a Fool’ and includes ‘If The Stars Were Mine’ and ‘Les Étoiles,’ before concluding with the Chet Baker hit ‘You Don’t Know What Love Is.’ Melody Gardot (piano, guitar, vocals) is accompanied by Charles Staab (drums), Sam Minaie (double bass), Mitchell Long (guitar), Sylvain Gontard (trumpet), Ludovic Beier (accordion), Artyom Manoukyan (cello), and Guillaume Latour, Alexandra Kondo, and Benjamin Ducasse (violin).
